svg.title: The AI-strategy pipeline — multivenue trading engine
svg.desc: Eight stages: six venues stream into the engine, which writes append-only PMLR capture; offline Python folds that capture into a candle/funding/IV/depth store and per-run feature files; a strategist (Claude-in-session today, the keyed serve daemon at Stage 3) authors a ruleset in a fixed 17-feature grammar; the ruleset is scored by the real engine VM replaying the real capture and must pass five hard gates; a passing artifact is installed by content hash, staged and committed over an 82-byte HMAC UDS frame, validated a second time by the same validator, and flipped live in the VM; from then on it trades on every tick with no AI in the loop; audit-pnl, parity and audit-replay close the loop back into the next authoring round.
svg.text: The AI-strategy pipeline
capture → derive → author → gate → promote → execute → observe · live state 2026-08-30 (VM2 V8)
live today
code-complete · deferred to the Stage-3 gate
load-bearing rule — the pipeline breaks without it
artifact on disk
A · CAPTURE — engine, Rust, continuous, no AI in the loop
ingress-* threads — pinned cores · mio + rustls · handwritten byte scanners · zero allocation · no tokio, no serde_json
venue bytes → normalized 64 B Tick · ChannelEvent · OptSummary · DepthTopK
SPSC rings → Engine::tick() — single writer
lock-free · POD · 64 B aligned · generic over Strategy, monomorphized (no dyn)
PmlrCapture (per ingress) + SlotCapture (engine)
the SAME record appended to disk · §6.5: capture IS the product — an open failure is a fatal boot error
~/multivenue/logs/run-<epoch_ns>/ — PMLR v2 · 64 B header + fixed-width slots · append-only · O(1) slot-indexed · torn-tail tolerant · one gap-free run per UTC day
kind 0 <venue>-ticks · 1 -signals · 2 engine-fills · 3 engine-orders (the attribution log) · 4 ai-cmds · 5 -events · 6 -opt-summary · 7 -depth (192 B slots) · optional <venue>-raw.tap
instrument-manifest.tsv — sym → descriptor, rewritten EVERY boot. Option and PM-daily ordinals reshuffle per boot BY DESIGN:

every offline consumer joins by DESCRIPTOR string (okx:BTC-USDT, binance-usdm:cotiusdt, deribit:BTC-30AUG26-77500-C, bare PM token id) — never a bare SymbolId. Skipping this produced a phantom $248.8M bound in V7.
B · DERIVE + FETCH — worker, Python, offline, globally serialized (never the hot path)
worker MODULES (launchd cadence — modules, never verbs)
candles · funding · iv_digest · depth_digest · refdata
channel_map (per-descriptor capability) · coverage_audit (hollow-lane report)
claude-worker fetch --replay-dir D [--symbols] [--news]
public keyless REST: PM Gamma · OKX candles · Deribit chart · HL candleSnapshot
RestBudget 60 req / venue / h · budgets pooled per HOST · --news is mechanical, NO LLM runs here
candles.db — the research data plane (SQLite WAL)
tables: candles · candle_conflicts · funding · iv_digest · depth_digest · refdata
PK (venue, descriptor, tf, open_ts) — NEVER a bare SymbolId
fetch 1m / 1h / 1d · derive 5m / 15m / 4h EXACTLY (O=first H=max L=min C=last V=sum)
closed bars are immutable — a disagreeing re-fetch is a logged conflict · capture bars carry NULL volume (we capture BBO, not prints)
features/<run>/ — the digest inputs (files only, never a socket)
<sym>.json (BBO / mid / spread / tick-rate) · <sym>-ohlcv.json · <sym>-meta.json
news/items-<ns>.ndjson — pulled and deduped mechanically; the session is the triage brain
market-map.json { markets: name → sym, hip4_pairs }
refresh is ADDITIVE ONLY — a name that now resolves elsewhere is a reported CONFLICT; the operator entry wins · tmp + os.replace
C · AUTHOR — the strategist reads FILES only, never a socket
Claude-in-session — SEMI-MANUAL · this is what runs today
cookbook: docs/prompts/ai-session.md §4 (pinned by test_session_scripted.py — doc and code cannot drift)
catalog: docs/research-universe.md · digest: features · candles.db · market-map · positions · pnl-<day>.json
acts EXCLUSIVELY through the frozen verbs · one action → verify → log → next · never parallelize (one seq namespace)
claude-worker serve → strategist.py → claude-fable-5 ⟨STAGE 3⟩
ResearchCycle: fetch → propose → backtest → (fail ⇒ ONE revision) → promote → arm monitor
6 h cadence · ≤2 calls per cycle · hard daily cap 12 · SQLite prompt cache · no-fresh-capture ⇒ cycle skipped
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is NOT provisioned ⇒ serve has never run and no Anthropic call is made from this stack
the ruleset artifact — { "rows": [ … ] } · 1–256 rows · identity = SHA-256 of the FILE BYTES (first 32 hex = hash128, which is all that travels on the wire)

every row is one statement: signal = combine( feat_a(instrument, window_a), feat_b(ref, window_b) ) — every feature and combine output is an i64 in ×1e9 of its natural unit; thresholds live in the same domain

17 features: mid · bid · ask | roll_mean · roll_ema · roll_min · roll_max · roll_std (window 1–4320 min) | apr24 · apr72 · clock_to_funding | mark_px · mark_iv | depth_imb · depth_spread_bps · depth_notional | clock_utc_sod

4 combines: diff · diff_bps · ratio_1e9 · lhs_only positions: exit ⇔ position row · ONE exit law signal × entry_sign ≤ exit · min/max_hold_s · group = at most one position, first row wins · max_risk_usd is PER LEG
D · GATE — the real engine VM replays the real capture · exit 3 is final, no override flag exists anywhere
claude-worker backtest --ruleset R.json [--replay-dir D] [--split 70/30]
the FROZEN contract — the harness conforms to the worker, never the reverse
backtest.py + cli.py byte-untouched across five sessions
subprocess → multivenue-engine backtest --ruleset R --replay-dir D --split 70/30
schema-1 JSON on stdout ONLY (stdout purity law) · human summary to stderr
report hash must equal the recomputed file hash, else the report is untrusted (exit 2)
R.report.json
written on PASS *and* FAIL
it is the gate-binding evidence
inside the harness — the same code that trades. Doctrine: the backtest may under-promise; it must never over-promise.
k-way merge, total order (ts_ns, venue byte, record idx)
VIRT_T0 rebase · runs never interleave
the SAME ingress_ai::validate_ruleset — no 2nd parser can drift
the REAL VmStrategy, via receive_table_v2 + a synthesized Commit
warmup is TABLE-GLOBAL: one apr72 row zeroes a root under 72 h
FillEngine — strict-cross maker, zero RNG
a resting BID at P fills only when ask < P (through, never a touch)
fill px is always P · displayed size is a SHARED FIFO budget
latency Δ: PM 200 ms · BN/OKX/Deribit/Bybit 100 ms · HL 600 ms
caps 8/sym, 64 total · D-7 options: mark ± max(0.5%, 1 tick), TAKER
manifest rebind by descriptor; dead descriptors DROP all records
fees round UP · net rounds DOWN · DD and bounds round UP
fixed point: px/qty ×1e6, money ×1e12 — no floats
70/30 on the virtual clock — TWO books over one fill stream:
full (IS+OOS) → bounds · OOS-emitted only → the verdict · PMLR ONLY, never candles
the five gates — GateThresholds, claude-worker/src/claude_worker/backtest.py
OOS net > $0.00 (strict) · ≥ 50 LEGS (+ ≥ 10 round trips iff position_rows > 0) · ≥ 1 OOS trading day (amended 2 → 1 on 2026-08-30, MVP tempo)
max drawdown ≤ $7,500 · OBSERVED bounds ≤ $10k order / $20k symbol / $100k table — a breach ANYWHERE in IS+OOS disqualifies
verdict
exit 0 — gates passed, promotion is permitted
exit 3 — GATES REFUSED. Final. No --override / --force / --skip-gates
exit 2 — report untrusted · 4 transport · 5 state
exit 3 ⇒ revise the table and re-gate
exit 0 ⇒ promote
E · PROMOTE — every step can only tighten
1 · install by content hash
cp R.json → $AI_RULESET_DIR/<hash128>.json
32 lowercase hex + .json · default ~/multivenue/artifacts/rulesets
the frame carries ONLY the hash — never the bytes
2 · stage-ruleset --ruleset R --report R.report.json
THE GATE BINDING SITE — recompute SHA-256; require schema 1,
matching ruleset_hash, and gates.all_passed — else GateRefused, exit 3
registry row in state.db FIRST, then send (record-then-send)
3 · commit-ruleset --hash <64 hex>
requires a STAGED, gates-passed registry row — else exit 3
send FIRST, then record (a failed send leaves no phantom commit)
a re-stage of the same hash CLEARS committed_ts
the wire — one-way, single-client AF_UNIX at $AI_INGRESS_SOCK · parent dir 0700 · socket 0600 · peer-euid checked · NO response frame ever
[ len u16 LE = 80 ][ AiCmd 64 B ][ tag 16 B ] tag = HMAC-SHA256(AI_INGRESS_HMAC_KEY, cmd[0..64])[0..16] hash128 rides in px (bytes 0–7) + qty (bytes 8–15)

kind 7 RulesetStage · kind 8 RulesetCommit · strategy_id pinned to 5 · seq from ONE monotonic SQLite allocator; every verb sends an implicit Heartbeat first (live: stage seq 48 / commit seq 50) · a verb only reports "sent" — /metrics and ai-cmds.pmlr confirm application
ingress-ai · the §4.4 accept path (the ORDER is load-bearing)
1 len == 80 → 2 HMAC, constant-time → 3 validate_shape → 4 seq policy
5 ts_ns REWRITTEN to engine monotonic — the audit chain is our clock, not the sender's claim
6 appended to ai-cmds.pmlr BEFORE the ring push — a ring-dropped command stays auditable
7 try_push · Stage/Commit additionally routed to the side-path seam · fail at 1–2 drops the conn, at 3 discards the frame
RulesetSidePath — the SECOND validation (off hot path; may allocate)
reads $AI_RULESET_DIR/<hex>.json (documented copy #0) into a Box<RuleTableV2> allocated once at boot
validate_ruleset rules 1–10 · rule 1 IS the hash check and strictly precedes any parsing
descriptors resolve HERE, against THIS boot's DescriptorTable — unresolvable ⇒ refuse
epoch := epoch + 1 · push RuleTableV2 (32,832 B) onto a 2-slot ring · a new Stage SUPERSEDES an old Commit
inside ONE Engine::tick() — the table lane is drained immediately BEFORE the AI lane, so a Stage and a Commit arriving in the same batch always land in order
table lane → StrategySet::on_ruleset_table → vm.receive_table_v2 ⇒ tables[(active&1)^1] = table, staged_valid = true — NOT mask-gated

AI lane → on_ai(RulesetCommit) fans out to ENABLED members only ⇒ MASK-GATED by BIT_VM (32) ⇒ active ^= 1 · the flip is an index swap, zero copy · rebind ≤4 feature legs/row · all 256 last_fire_ns = 0, all positions FLAT

⇒ THE ASYMMETRY: with slot 5 disabled you can still STAGE — the table survives the disabled window — but the Commit is silently swallowed. Recovery is ENABLE, then RE-COMMIT. Never enable alone, never restage first.
F · EXECUTE — on every tick, with NO AI, no worker and no cron in the loop

StrategySet is statically composed — no dyn, no allocation after boot. --strategy all requests 63; slots 1/2/3 need flags the launchd wrapper never passes ⇒ the live mask is 63 & 49 = 49. Disable slot 5 ⇒ 17; re-enable ⇒ 49.
slot 0 · latency-arb
bit 1 · ON · not AI-authored
slot 1 · ev
bit 2 · off (needs --artifacts-path)
slot 2 · cross-arb
bit 4 · off (needs --groups)
slot 3 · rule-tree
bit 8 · off (needs --rules-path)
slot 4 · ai-exec (s4)
bit 16 · ON · Intent lane, cron-driven
slot 5 · vm (s5)
bit 32 · ON · THE RULESET VM
StampCtx writes the slot into Order.strategy_id (byte 41 of the 64 B Order) on submit
one register write, fully monomorphized — that is the WHOLE attribution mechanism
VM per tick: features always update · empty table ⇒ inert · exits first (age-out → min_hold → exit law), then entries (cooldown → confirm)
engine-orders.pmlr — every ACCEPTED intent, stamped s0 / s4 / s5
paper-only until the operator opens the Stage-3 gate · refusals are counters, not records
per-RULESET attribution is deliberately not embedded — it is reconstructed offline from the RulesetCommit timeline in ai-cmds.pmlr
G · OBSERVE — and the edge that closes the loop
audit-pnl --dir
reuses backtest::fill VERBATIM,
boundary 0 — the gate and the
shadow book speak one economics
per slot AND per ruleset hash
pnl_report → the pnl verb
nightly 00:20Z timer
reports/pnl-<day>.json
+ .summary.txt
pnl is a THIN reader — no socket
parity --window-h 48
s4 cron vs s5 VM · ONE ground
truth: engine-orders.pmlr
tolerances xv 600 s / carry 7200 s
GREEN = 0 misses AND 0 sign disagreements
audit-replay --dir run-<ns>
cadence bands · sequence integrity
venue × channel coverage matrix
the FULL AI-command chain —
how the rollback was proven, not asserted
/metrics on 127.0.0.1
engine_vm_rows_active · _table_epoch
engine_vm_fires_total · _orders_*
engine_ai_ruleset_{staged,committed,
rejected}_total · engine_strategy_enabled_mask

Parity window OPEN since ~2026-08-30 08:55Z · judged PER FAMILY, never globally · known standing miss: the xv cron still carries the hl↔bn-usdm pair the retune dropped · cron bootout is OPERATOR-ONLY, per family, after that family is green (the data agents stay)
shadow P&L · walk-forward · parity ⇒ the next authoring digest
H · RESTART CONTINUITY — committed tables are IN-MEMORY ONLY

The engine reads NOTHING ruleset-related at boot: the VM boots inert (rows_active 0, epoch 0, hash all-zero). That is normal, not an error. Two backgrounded hooks in scripts/engine-wrapper.sh restore state.
scripts/engine-wrapper.sh
one-engine guard (pgrep) · source .env · universe refresh
exec multivenue-engine run --paper --strategy all
it NEVER builds — the G0 relink law is the operator's
daily graceful restarts at 00:00 / 08:30 / 16:05Z
recommit-ruleset.sh — operator ruling #7b
python -m claude_worker.recommit --wait-sock-seconds 180
re-stages + re-commits the registry's ACTIVE ruleset
because descriptors resolve at STAGE time, this is what re-binds
options and PM dailies to THIS boot's ordinals · refuses rather than guesses
seed-push.sh — after a 45 s grace
the grace lets #7b land first: a seed against an inert VM is refused
FundingSeed (kind 10) — 73 h of raw prints ⇒ apr24/apr72 warm at once
PositionSeed (kind 11) — prior slot-5 FIFO fold · qty = age in SECONDS
live-proven 2026-08-30: 1,669 frames · 52 descriptors · rejected 0
post-boot re-stage + re-commit + seeds re-enter the wire (kinds 7 · 8 · 10 · 11)
The AI is a compiler, not a runtime: nothing it produces ever executes as code — it emits data that a handwritten validator either admits or rejects.

One validator, shared by harness and engine. The gate is bound to the artifact by hash. Caps are enforced three times — validator rule 7 · the VM's own per-order policy · observed bounds — and only tightening is possible.
Deferred to the Stage-3 entry gate (docs/mvp-completion-plan.md §7): ANTHROPIC_API_KEY provisioning ⇒ serve + Fable-5 authoring · §8.1 auto-promotion · §8.3 monitor + §8.5 automatic rollback.

The monitor's shape is fully specified: the ACTIVE ruleset re-run over a trailing 24 h at --split 0/100, floor 6 h (below it it SKIPS — it never guesses), trigger net ≤ −$100 or DD ≥ $200, act by Disable-5 then restage-and-commit the prior.
All of it is code-complete and E2E-proven; the LIVE proofs ARE the gate, and the gate is the operator's to open. Companion walkthrough: docs/ai-strategy-pipeline.md
